name: Warm Shrimp Salad with Mixed Veggies, Avocado & Lemon Caper Dressing
ingredients: 1 ½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spring mix if it came pre-washed.)

If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals (if using fresh shrimp, skip this step). Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry. Set aside.
Juice the lemon into the small bowl. Shave leaves off the parsley stems; discard the stems, mince the leaves and add to the bowl.
Finely chop the anchovy fillets. Add to the bowl along with mayo, capers, oil, Dijon, and salt; whisk to combine dressing and set aside.
Trim green onions and cut them crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle; place in a medium bowl.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim zucchini, halve lengthwise, and cut crosswise into ¼-inch-thick half-rounds.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom, then add zucchini and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Remove zucchini to the bowl with the onion and return the skillet to medium-high heat. Add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add shrimp, garlic, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Cook, stirring often, until cooked through and slightly golden, about 4 minutes; remove from the heat.
Meanwhile, halve and pit the avocado; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide mixed greens between plates; top with shrimp, vegetables, avocado, and dressing. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
